questions.question: The quarterly report has been delayed ______ the server outage.
questions.explanation: due to 表原因，后接名词短语，表示“由于”之意。

questions.question: Please ______ the attendance sheet before submitting it to HR.
questions.explanation: 祈使句用动词原形 fill out，表示“填写”。

questions.question: The new project manager is ______ experienced in handling large teams.
questions.explanation: 副词 very 修饰形容词 experienced，表示“非常有经验”。

questions.question: The company ______ to expand its operations in Asia next year.
questions.explanation: 主语为第三人称单数，一般现在时 plans to do 表计划。

questions.question: The team remains ______ on schedule despite the recent setbacks.
questions.explanation: ahead of schedule 固定搭配，表示“提前于计划”。

questions.question: The manager asked us to review the proposal ______ before the board meeting.
questions.explanation: 副词 carefully 修饰动词 review，表示“仔细地”。

questions.question: They arrived ______ than we had expected, so we saved time.
questions.explanation: 句中有 than，需用比较级 earlier。

questions.question: The minutes will be distributed ______ the meeting ends.
questions.explanation: after 引导时间状语从句，表示“会议结束后分发”。

questions.question: The presentation will start ______ the CEO arrives.
questions.explanation: when 引导时间状语从句，表示“当总裁到达时”。

questions.question: I will send you the documents ______ I finish proofreading them.
questions.explanation: as soon as 引导时间状语从句，表示“一……就……”。

questions.question: The new project manager was ______ from our main competitor.
questions.explanation: was recruited 为被动语态，表示“被招聘”。

questions.question: The quarterly report ______ to be completed by next Friday.
questions.explanation: be expected to do 固定搭配，表示“预计要做”。

questions.question: The server room is located ______ the third floor of the building.
questions.explanation: on the third floor 表示“在三楼”，楼层前用 on。

questions.question: Our office is ______ the main conference center, so it is easy to find.
questions.explanation: next to 表示“紧邻”，位置关系最贴切。

questions.question: Please confirm your attendance ______ this Friday.
questions.explanation: by this Friday 表示“最迟本周五前”，固定时间表达。

questions.question: Thank you for your cooperation ______ our company guidelines.
questions.explanation: cooperation in doing sth 固定搭配，表示“在某事上的配合”。

questions.question: The audit is scheduled to be completed ______ the end of the fiscal year.
questions.explanation: by the end of 表示“到……结束时为止”。

questions.question: The investment portfolio has ______ steadily since we began managing it.
questions.explanation: has grown 为现在完成时，与 since 搭配。

questions.question: All participants must ______ for the event at least one week in advance.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 must 后接动词原形 register。

questions.question: Full-time employees are entitled ______ to use the company car.
questions.explanation: be entitled to do 固定搭配，表示“有权做某事”。

questions.question: The venue provides ______ for all conference attendees.
questions.explanation: provide 后接名词，accommodations 表“住宿设施”。

questions.question: The sales team achieved ______ quarterly targets ahead of schedule.
questions.explanation: team 指成员整体可用复数代词 their。

questions.question: The financial statement shows ______ growth compared with last quarter.
questions.explanation: 形容词 significant 修饰名词 growth，表示“显著的”。

questions.question: Customer feedback indicates a ______ level of satisfaction with our service.
questions.explanation: 形容词 high 修饰名词 level，high level of 表“高水平的”。

questions.question: The product launch was ______ the market research data.
questions.explanation: be based on 固定搭配，表示“基于……”。

questions.question: We will ______ whether to renew the contract after evaluating the results.
questions.explanation: will 后接动词原形 decide。

questions.question: The exhibition schedule includes ______ networking sessions for attendees.
questions.explanation: several 修饰可数名词复数 sessions，表示“几个”。

questions.question: The conference venue is conveniently located ______ the city center.
questions.explanation: near 表示“靠近”，与 conveniently located 搭配自然。

questions.question: The system requires ______ updates to function properly.
questions.explanation: 形容词 regular 修饰名词 updates，表“定期的更新”。

questions.question: The shipment was ______ due to unexpected customs delays.
questions.explanation: was delayed 为被动语态，表示“被延误”。

questions.question: Our bank agrees to ______ competitive interest rates for overseas accounts.
questions.explanation: agree to do sth 固定搭配，to 后接动词原形 offer。

questions.question: The training session will be ______ in the main auditorium next Monday.
questions.explanation: will be held 为被动语态将来时，表示“将被举行”。

questions.question: The logistics budget has been ______ managed this year.
questions.explanation: 副词 well 修饰动词 managed，be well managed 表“管理良好”。

questions.question: The recruitment process has been ______ because of budget constraints.
questions.explanation: has been suspended 为现在完成被动，表示“已被暂停”。

questions.question: The marketing campaign should be ______ to the needs of younger consumers.
questions.explanation: be tailored to 固定搭配，表示“为……量身定制”。

questions.question: The quarterly figures show ______ improvement over the same period last year.
questions.explanation: 形容词 significant 修饰名词 improvement。

questions.question: We should ______ the meeting agenda to all staff members in advance.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 should 后接动词原形 circulate，表示“传阅”。

questions.question: The client requested ______ presentation materials by tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: the 表示特指双方已知的具体材料。

questions.question: After the meeting, the manager will ______ the action items to each department.
questions.explanation: will 后接动词原形 distribute，表示“分发”。
